sources.title_en: Claude Code gets a /design command that lets developers create UI mockups right in the terminal
sources.title_original: Claude Code gets a /design command that lets developers create UI mockups right in the terminal
sources.summary: With the /design command, Anthropic brings a visual design workflow directly into Claude Code. Developers can generate UI mockups as artboards right in the terminal before writing any code. Claude reads the existing codebase and matches the current UI style. The article Claude Code gets a /design command that lets developers create UI mockups right in the terminal appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 透過 /design 命令，Anthropic 將視覺化設計工作流程直接引入 Claude Code。開發人員可以在編寫任何程式碼之前在終端中生成 UI 模型作為畫板。 Claude 讀取現有的程式碼庫並匹配當前的 UI 風格。文章 Claude Code 獲取 /design 命令，讓開發人員可以直接在終端中建立 UI 模型，該文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

sources.summary: Zhipu’s release note for GLM-5.3 contains a sentence that did not make it into most of the coverage. Describing its own cybersecurity results, the Beijing company writes that capability “is growing fastest exactly where we are furthest behind.” Zhipu, which also trades as Z.ai, is one of a handful of Chinese labs releasing models that compete with […] The post Reading Zhipu’s GLM-5.3 results past the headline number appeared first on AI News .
sources.summary_zh: GLM-5.3 的 智譜的 發行說明包含一個未納入大部分報道的句子。這家北京公司在描述自己的網路安全成果時寫道，能力“增長最快的地方正是我們落後的地方。” 智譜（也稱為 智譜）是少數幾個釋出與 [...] 競爭模型的中國實驗室之一。閱讀 智譜的 GLM-5.3 結果超過標題數字的帖子首先出現在 AI News 上。

sources.title: 人工智慧系統在壓縮上下文時會悄悄地丟棄使用者指令 / AI systems quietly drop user instructions when they compress context
sources.title_zh: 人工智慧系統在壓縮上下文時會悄悄地丟棄使用者指令
sources.title_en: AI systems quietly drop user instructions when they compress context
sources.title_original: AI systems quietly drop user instructions when they compress context
sources.summary: When AI systems condense long conversations, they drop an average of 83 percent of user rules, like "don't send emails without my approval." Penn State researchers propose a small add-on module built on Qwen3.5-9B that preserves over 90 percent of these restrictions. The article AI systems quietly drop user instructions when they compress context appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 當人工智慧系統壓縮長對話時，它們平均會放棄 83% 的使用者規則，例如“未經我批准，請勿傳送電子郵件”。賓夕法尼亞州立大學的研究人員提出了一個基於 Qwen3.5-9B 構建的小型附加模組，該模組保留了 90% 以上的限制。文章《人工智慧系統在壓縮上下文時悄悄地丟棄使用者指令》首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

sources.title_original: OpenAI簽下俄亥俄州8GW AI運算基地，Nvidia投資15億美元
sources.summary: OpenAI週一（8/17）宣佈，將在美國俄亥俄州派克郡（Pike County）的PORTS-Pike科技園區取得約8GW的AI運算容量，並與SB Energy、Nvidia及美國能源部合作開發。第一批800MW容量預計2028年上線，整體建設期預計持續至2032年。

stories.title: AI影片市場從Sora's起步反彈 / AI video market has bounced back from Sora's false start

sources.title: AI影片市場從Sora's起步反彈 / AI video market has bounced back from Sora's false start
sources.title_zh: AI影片市場從Sora's起步反彈
sources.title_en: AI video market has bounced back from Sora's false start
sources.title_original: AI video market has bounced back from Sora's false start
sources.summary: AI production companies like Promise are setting up shop around Hollywood's historic studios, using real-time backgrounds and other AI tools to cut film costs. Netflix already uses AI in 300 of its 1,000 titles, and the startup Higgsfield now carries a $5.4 billion valuation. What was once a tech demo has grown into its own industry, complete with valuations, job titles, and fights over who gets a cut. The article AI video market has bounced back from Sora's false start appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 像 Promise 這樣的人工智慧製作公司正在好萊塢歷史悠久的工作室周圍設立工作室，使用實時背景和其他人工智慧工具來削減電影成本。 Netflix 已在其 1,000 部作品中的 300 部中使用了人工智慧，初創公司 Higgsfield 目前估值為 54 億美元。曾經的技術演示已經發展成為自己的行業，包括估值、職位頭銜以及對誰能獲得提成的爭論。 《AI 影片市場已從 Sora's 錯誤開始中反彈》一文首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

stories.title: Nous Research 為 Hermes 代理提供機器人模式，將代理資料轉變為命名機器人名冊 / Nous Research Ships Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, Turning Agent Profiles Into a Roster of Named Bots

sources.title: Nous Research 為 Hermes 代理提供機器人模式，將代理資料轉變為命名機器人名冊 / Nous Research Ships Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, Turning Agent Profiles Into a Roster of Named Bots
sources.title_zh: Nous Research 為 Hermes 代理提供機器人模式，將代理資料轉變為命名機器人名冊
sources.title_en: Nous Research Ships Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, Turning Agent Profiles Into a Roster of Named Bots
sources.title_original: Nous Research Ships Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, Turning Agent Profiles Into a Roster of Named Bots
sources.summary: Nous Research has shipped Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, its MIT-licensed open source agent. Bot Mode replaces the single-agent session list with a roster of named bots. Each bot is a real Hermes profile, with its own chat, memory, skills, and pinned model. It is now bundled and default-on in Hermes Desktop. The post Nous Research Ships Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, Turning Agent Profiles Into a Roster of Named Bots appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Nous Research 已經為 Hermes Agent 提供了 Bot 模式，Hermes Agent 是其 MIT 許可的開源代理。機器人模式用指定機器人名冊取代單代理會話列表。每個機器人都是真正的 Hermes 個人資料，具有自己的聊天、記憶、技能和固定模型。它現在已捆綁並在 Hermes Desktop 中預設開啟。 Nous Research 為 Hermes Agent 提供 Bot 模式，將 Agent 配置檔案轉化為命名機器人名冊，該文章首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

sources.title_original: Anthropic Claude於8月16日發生大當機，AI、API與Claude Code等多項服務均受影響
sources.summary: Anthropic的Claude服務8月16日（臺灣時間8月17日）發生大規模服務中斷，臺灣時間8月17日凌晨5時58分起陸續出現登入驗證問題，Anthropic於臺灣時間上午6時02分確認發生問題，並表示影響範圍已經擴大，包括Claude.ai、Claude Console、Claude API、Claude Code與Claude Cowork等多項服務均出現效能下降。

stories.title: 地熱電廠導入5G AI-RAN專網，結合AI提升巡檢效率20%、夏季發電效率增5%

sources.title: 地熱電廠導入5G AI-RAN專網，結合AI提升巡檢效率20%、夏季發電效率增5%
sources.title_zh: 地熱電廠導入5G AI-RAN專網，結合AI提升巡檢效率20%、夏季發電效率增5%
sources.title_original: 地熱電廠導入5G AI-RAN專網，結合AI提升巡檢效率20%、夏季發電效率增5%
sources.summary: AI應用、資料中心與高科技製造持續增加用電需求，發展穩定的低碳電力成為國內推動能源轉型的重要課題，其中運用地熱發電是一個重要的低碳電力來源，位於新北市金山的四磺子坪及硫磺子兩座地熱發電廠近期匯入5G AI-RAN專網、Edge AI、AIoT與生成式AI維運等技術。地熱電廠匯入機器狗智慧巡檢、能源最佳化分析及生成式AI維運系統 ，巡檢效率提高逾20%，夏季發電效率提升5%以上，建立國內綠能發電智慧維運管理的應用案例。 這項計畫由臺灣大哥大與將捷集團旗下結元能源開發合作推動，在國發會「AI+產業智慧共創實證計畫－AI服務大平臺整合次世代通訊之生態共創服務計畫」支援之下進行，希望驗證AI結合5G通訊在綠能發電場域的應用成效，建立可複製的智慧能源維運模式。

sources.summary: Anthropic has clarified how it's planning to apply invisible watermarks to Claude-generated text in order to comply with Europe's AI transparency rules. stories.title: Qwen 3.8 27B 在人工智慧分析智慧指數上得分 52 / Qwen 3.8 27B scores 52 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index

sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B 在人工智慧分析智慧指數上得分 52 / Qwen 3.8 27B scores 52 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
sources.title_zh: Qwen 3.8 27B 在人工智慧分析智慧指數上得分 52
sources.title_en: Qwen 3.8 27B scores 52 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
sources.title_original: Qwen 3.8 27B scores 52 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
sources.summary: Qwen 3.8 27B scores 52 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index That's the same score as GPT-5.6 Luna (max), and just one point behind GLM-5.2 (max) and DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 (max) - that GLM is 753B and that DeepSeek is 1.7T parameters , and Luna is size unknown but presumably a whole lot bigger than 27B. Qwen 3.8 27B is a truly astonishing model . Via Hacker News Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , qwen , ai-in-china , artificial-analysis
sources.summary_zh: Qwen 3.8 27B 在人工智慧分析指數上得分為 52，與 GPT-5.6 Luna（最大值）得分相同，僅落後 GLM-5.2（最大值）和 DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813（最大值）一分 - GLM 為 753B，DeepSeek 為 1.7T 參數，Luna 大小未知，但可能比 27B 大很多。 Qwen 3.8 27B 是一款真正令人驚歎的型號。來自駭客新聞 標籤： 人工智慧 , 生成人工智慧 , llms , qwen , 人工智慧在中國 , 人工分析

sources.title_original: Google用HEIR推進同態加密AI推論，擴展私密推論應用
sources.summary: Google展示同態加密編譯器HEIR最新進展，可將原本處理未加密資料的預先訓練AI模型，轉換成能直接處理加密輸入的版本。Google同步公佈內容推薦、信用卡詐欺偵測、網路異常偵測與語音觸發詞偵測4種應用，讓雲端服務在不必解密或看到使用者原始資料的情況下執行AI推論。

sources.title: 我們追蹤了一批善本書籍。它在 亞馬遜 人工智慧培訓設施結束 / We Tracked a Shipment of Rare Books. It Ended at an Amazon AI Training Facility
sources.title_zh: 我們追蹤了一批善本書籍。它在 亞馬遜 人工智慧培訓設施結束
sources.title_en: We Tracked a Shipment of Rare Books. It Ended at an Amazon AI Training Facility
sources.title_original: We Tracked a Shipment of Rare Books. It Ended at an Amazon AI Training Facility
sources.summary: We Tracked a Shipment of Rare Books. It Ended at an Amazon AI Training Facility Excellent piece of reporting from 404 Media. For a while now there have been stories of book dealers receiving orders for large volumes of books from apparently price-insensitive anonymous customers, widely suspected to be companies looking to scan them for AI training (see my previous coverage of Anthropic's book scanning from June 2025.) 404 Media investigated with an AirTag! In July, one bookseller told me they received a very large order of around 1,000 books on Biblio, one of these marketplaces. The seller agreed to put an Apple AirTag provided by 404 Media in one of the books included in this order so we could see where the book was going. And by extension, which company, AI or otherwise, was behind this massive order. The book ended up delivered to the VGT3 corner of the LAS8 Amazon facility in the north east of Las Vegas, where the entrance carried this on-the-nose logo of a dinosaur with a book! Photo credit: 404 Media Online forum discussions between Amazon workers confirmed that VGT3 destructively scans large volumes of books. Tags: amazon , journalism , ai , training-data , ai-ethics , 404-media

items.summary: We Tracked a Shipment of Rare Books. It Ended at an Amazon AI Training Facility Excellent piece of reporting from 404 Media. For a while now there have been stories of book dealers receiving orders for large volumes of books from apparently price-insensitive anonymous customers, widely suspected to be companies looking to scan them for AI training (see my previous coverage of Anthropic's book scanning from June 2025.) 404 Media investigated with an AirTag! In July, one bookseller told me they received a very large order of around 1,000 books on Biblio, one of these marketplaces. The seller agreed to put an Apple AirTag provided by 404 Media in one of the books included in this order so we could see where the book was going. And by extension, which company, AI or otherwise, was behind this massive order. The book ended up delivered to the VGT3 corner of the LAS8 Amazon facility in the north east of Las Vegas, where the entrance carried this on-the-nose logo of a dinosaur with a book! Photo credit: 404 Media Online forum discussions between Amazon workers confirmed that VGT3 destructively scans large volumes of books.
